# Unify Consulting () - SVP Technical Pre-Sales and Enterprise Solution Architecture briefing packet

## JD Complement
The role sits in a services-led consulting firm where technical credibility must convert into enterprise trust, not just architecture quality. The operating tension is between selling a credible transformation path and ensuring delivery
teams can execute it without overpromising.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Unify Consulting is a management consulting and business services firm founded in 2006, with a positioning that blends strategy, AI, data, and people. Its archetype is hybrid: advisory-led, implementation-aware, and partner-enabled.

The company appears to win by translating complex enterprise change into practical delivery. That means the role likely has to bridge executive discovery, solution shaping, and handoff into implementation teams.

Core operating characteristics:
- Human-centered consulting wrapped around technical depth
- Enterprise transformation work across strategy, data, AI, and platform execution
- A flexible alternative to larger consultancies, with more tailored engagement design
- Solution credibility that depends on both advisory framing and hands-on technical patterns

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Verified company context points to a firm that is not product-led; it is selling expertise, trust, and execution quality. That creates pressure to differentiate on speed, specificity, and measurable business outcomes rather than broad
transformation language.

The company also appears to have a multi-location footprint and a consulting model that spans business strategy, organizational effectiveness, product management, data analysis, quality engineering, and security. That breadth suggests the
role must help unify disparate specialist capabilities into a coherent enterprise story.

The central decision-rights tension is likely this: who owns the customer narrative from first technical conversation through delivery readiness. This role probably exists to keep pre-sales, solution design, and implementation aligned
enough to protect margin and credibility.

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
Verified leadership detail is limited in the available record. The company was founded by Darren Alger, but no broader leadership roster is verified here.

Likely stakeholder map, based on the company model:
- Consulting leadership, for growth priorities and account strategy
- Practice leaders across AI, data, Salesforce, security, and engineering
- Delivery leads, for feasibility, staffing, and implementation sequencing
- Partner or alliance contacts, where cloud and platform motions shape the solution
- Client executives, where business case and adoption risk matter as much as architecture

## AI, Data, Platform, Architecture Signals
Unify Consulting explicitly connects strategy, AI, data, and people, which signals an operating model built around enterprise transformation rather than isolated technical projects.

Verified platform and solution signals include:
- Advanced Salesforce solutions for complex industries
- Data Cloud, Experience Cloud, Service Cloud, and Billing Cloud emphasis
- AI and data as first-class consulting themes
- Security and quality engineering as part of the broader delivery mix

For this role, the important implication is that architecture is likely expected to be business-facing and composable. The company context favors referenceable patterns, reusable solution framing, and practical modernization paths over
abstract technical depth.

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Partnership motion is material here. Unify states that it partners with digital and cloud technology leaders, and it has a documented Google Cloud partnership. That suggests ecosystem credibility is part of the go-to-market model, not an
afterthought.

The partnership DNA likely includes:
- Co-selling with cloud and platform vendors
- Joint solution development around data and analytics
- Implementation-oriented partner positioning
- Technical validation that helps move enterprise deals forward

This matters for the role because alliance fluency may be part of how the firm wins larger pursuits and anchors solution credibility with buyers.

## Recent Events & Urgency
The available record shows a firm actively positioning itself as an AI management consulting firm and emphasizing advanced Salesforce and cloud partnerships. That implies urgency around staying relevant in a market where buyers expect AI,
data, and platform modernization to be bundled into one story.

The broader market pressure is clear: enterprises want consulting firms that can move from strategy to implementation without a long translation gap. This role likely exists to reduce that gap in complex pursuits.

## apps_rg Positioning Themes (targeting only, not proof)
- Enterprise pre-sales that connects technical depth to commercial outcomes
- Consulting-side solution architecture for AI, data, and cloud programs
- Partner-aware solution shaping with cloud and platform ecosystems
- Reusable reference architectures and implementation accelerators
- Executive-facing discovery that turns ambiguity into a delivery-ready plan
- Cross-functional alignment between sales, practice, and delivery teams
- Modernization narratives that are credible in services-led environments
- Customer-facing technical leadership in complex, multi-stakeholder pursuits

## apps_lic Outreach Angles (targeting only, not proof)
- Reference the firm’s blend of strategy, AI, data, and people as a differentiator
- Acknowledge the need to keep solution design aligned with delivery reality
- Mention cloud and platform partnerships as part of enterprise credibility
- Speak to reusable patterns that help consulting teams scale without losing customization
- Frame the conversation around reducing friction between pre-sales and implementation
- Note the importance of executive trust in advisory-led transformation deals
- Position around helping technical leaders support larger, more complex pursuits

## Do Not Use As Proof
The JD and this briefing are targeting inputs only. Candidate claims must come from the governed resume/proof graph.
